regulation_clause.text: Where the customer is a partnership firm, the beneficial owner is the natural person(s), who, whether acting alone or together, or through one or more juridical person, has/have ownership of/entitlement to more than 15 per cent of capital or profits of the partnership.

carried_instances.gold_rationale: The 2016 clause sets the partnership beneficial-owner threshold at strictly_greater 15 percent of capital or profits. WS-BO-THRESHOLD is declared VALUE 15.00 (line 18) and 2000-IDENTIFY-BO flags BO when either WS-CAPITAL-PCT or WS-PROFIT-PCT strictly exceeds that threshold (lines 27-29), matching the clause's value, comparator, and disjunctive capital-or-profits scope.

provenance.annotator_notes: Human primary annotation and Claude verification agreed on this classification without final review.

regulation_clause.text: For partnership firms, the beneficial owner is the natural person with ownership of/entitlement to more than 10 percent of capital or profits (lowered from 15 percent by the 2023-10-17 amendment to the 2016 MD).

carried_instances.gold_rationale: Clause 5(iv)(b) lowers the threshold to strictly_greater 10 percent (per the 2023-10-17 amendment). BOIDENT1 (byte-identical to the 2016-clause candidate) still declares WS-BO-THRESHOLD VALUE 15.00 (line 18) and compares against 15, not 10 -- a stale threshold value.

regulation_clause.text: Regulated entities must update KYC records in the Central KYC Records Registry within 7 days of receiving updated information from a customer.

carried_instances.gold_rationale: Clause 65(8) (footnote-148 insertion into the 2016 MD, now 2025 clause 65(8)) requires CKYCR updates within 7 days of receiving updated customer information (duration_days=7, at_most). KYCSYNC1's WORKING-STORAGE (lines 10-14) has no elapsed-day or date field at all, and 2000-QUEUE-UPLOAD only branches on the boolean WS-UPD-RECEIVED (line 23); there is no 7-day deadline check anywhere in the program's reachable logic.

regulation_clause.text: Where the customer is a partnership firm, the beneficial owner is the natural person(s), who, whether acting alone or together, or through one or more juridical person, has/have ownership of/entitlement to more than 15 per cent of capital or profits of the partnership.

carried_instances.gold_rationale: The 2016 clause requires entitlement to more than 15 percent of capital or profits. WS-EXCESS-PCT = WS-ENTITLEMENT-PCT - 15 (line 17) is positive exactly when entitlement strictly exceeds 15, read as a resolved combined capital-or-profits figure per the adjudication note.

provenance.annotator_notes: Adjudicated 2026-07-27: Pass 1 read WS-ENTITLEMENT-PCT as a resolved combined capital-or-profits figure (D7/D1); Pass 2 flagged genuine ambiguity given the single generic field. Resolved by comparative reading against sibling T6BO01/02/04/05 in the same evidence bundle: T6BO02 and T6BO04 each signal their single-dimension incompleteness through explicit field names (WS-PROFIT-SHARE, WS-CAPITAL-INTEREST); T6BO03's unqualified 'entitlement' naming has no such signal, and D2 requires the missing check to be established, not merely possible. Pass 1's reading is accepted.

regulation_clause.text: Where the customer is a partnership firm, the beneficial owner is the natural person(s), who, whether acting alone or together, or through one or more juridical person, has/have ownership of/entitlement to more than 15 per cent of capital or profits of the partnership.

carried_instances.gold_rationale: WS-PARTNER-PCT is an integer-only field (PIC 9(3), no decimal places), and 88-level LEGACY-BO-RANGE is declared VALUE 16 THRU 100 (line 8). Within this integer domain, 16 is the smallest value strictly greater than 15, so the range correctly implements the 2016 clause's strictly_greater 15 percent threshold for integer inputs.
